I have created the attributed reconstruction of the official Framer homepage based on the measured specifications and browser observations:

### Key Highlights & Specifications:
1. **Measured Typography & Viewport**:
   - Page background: solid deep black (`#000000`).
   - Hero headline: GT Walsheim Medium font styling with exact measurements (`54px / 54px`, letter-spacing `-2.16px`, weight 500) reading verbatim: *"Framer is the design agent for every step from idea to launch"*.
   - Section headings: `44px / 48.4px` with `-1.76px` tracking; subheads: Inter Variable `18px / 24.3px` with `-0.2px` tracking.
2. **Navigation & Action Elements**:
   - 64px fixed header with genuine Framer mark, dropdown menus (Platform, Solutions, Resources), Enterprise, Pricing, Log in, and white pill Sign up button.
   - Hero actions: "Get started for free", "Download app", and right-aligned "New: Skills" badge.
3. **Hero Media & Video**:
   - Reconstructed with the native video stream (`https://framerusercontent.com/assets/2zyGmnAWVTTdkv4LY1mFKgEdhg.mp4`), poster image, and the observed `0:36` pill timestamp control alongside "Meet our customers".
4. **Verified Sections**:
   - **Trusted by teams shipping big sites**: Inverted monochrome vector logos (Miro, Perplexity, Legora, Mixpanel, Zapier, Flora, Mutiny, StackAI).
   - **Agents that work alongside you, not instead of you**: Design with an agent (gallery previews), Run your CMS with an agent (live table with synced badges and items), Code with an agent, and Connect to any AI (Claude Code terminal UI).
   - **Not just vibes, a full platform**: 9-card production infrastructure grid with Performance (LCP 1.1s, INP 95ms, CLS 0.01), CMS, SEO, Collaboration, Localization, Hosting (99.99% uptime), Security, and Analytics & A/B testing.
   - **Shipped with Framer**: Verified showcase tiles featuring live public customer sites.
   - **Community & Marketplace**: Liquid Glass component feed, Trending templates, and creator profiles.
   - **Footer & Legal**: Full multi-column site directory, system status indicator, and attribution notice.
